defects: Restricts to Field K + FiniteDimensional K V instead of gold's general CommRing R, Module R M (no finite-dimensionality assumption) — adds hypotheses not present in gold, narrowing generality

Missing parentheses around the supremum: `⨆ μ : K, f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤` parses as `⨆ μ : K, (f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤)` (a supremum over Prop, i.e. essentially `∃ μ, f.maxGenEigenspace μ = ⊤`), not as `(⨆ μ : K, f.maxGenEigenspace μ) = ⊤` as in the gold; this changes the statement from 'the join of all generalized eigenspaces is the whole space' to 'a single eigenvalue's generalized eigenspace is the whole space', which is a different and much stronger claim, not mathematically equivalent to the gold
